changelog:
- Added support for recent-N-day reports (2–7 days) with filtering and larger fetch window (up to 250 records).
- Updated CLI and script interfaces: new --recent-days argument; --max-page capped at 25 in recent-days mode.
- Clarified output policy: scripts do not emit "投资事件总结"; final section must be AI-appended.
- Improved documentation and usage examples for multi-day reporting. 
- Removed sample card file (skill-card.md).
